summary: Frontend E2E testing of the new Paper Grader feature. All 7 review-request scenarios PASSED: (1) Sidebar shows 'Paper Grader' nav item (data-testid nav-paper grader) under Dashboard; clicking navigates to /paper-grader and page loads. (2) Weak paper .txt uploaded via paper-input → filename 'weak_paper.txt' visible in paper-dropzone; title 'Photosynthesis Weak Draft' set via paper-title-input. (3) Rubric .txt uploaded via rubric-input → 'rubric.txt' visible; rubric-clear works. (4) Clicking grade-btn shows 'Grading your paper…' loader, then grade-result appears (~15-25s). Weak paper scored overall-score=8% with 4 criterion cards (criterion-0..3): Comprehension 1/10, Structure 0/10, Scientific Accuracy 2/10, Depth of Analysis 0/10 — each with 'What you did right' and (since <10) 'How to reach 10/10'. (5) resubmit-btn visible when <100%; clicking it shows resubmit-banner, clears paper, and after uploading rich_paper.txt + grade → new result with attempt=2 linked (overall 90%; Structure & Scientific Accuracy hit 10/10 and correctly showed 'Full marks — nailed it!' with no 'How to reach 10/10' section). (6) 'Previous submissions' list showed both attempts (grade-<id> cards with percentages); open-grade-<id> reopens result view; delete confirmation appeared. (7) REGRESSION no-rubric: rubric-clear pressed then rich paper graded without rubric → grade-result rendered with Comprehension, Structure, Scientific Accuracy criteria present in default academic set (confirmed). Overall percentage ring, criterion score badges, animated progress bars, resubmit CTA, and history all wired correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: PaperGrader.js resubmit() calls setTimeout(() => paperRef.current?.click(), 300) to auto-open native OS file picker. In browsers this only works from a user-gesture handler; since it is inside setTimeout after a real click it usually works, but on stricter browsers the picker may silently fail. Consider triggering the click synchronously inside the resubmit onClick (before the setState batches flush) or leaving it to the user to click the dropzone — current UX is acceptable but slightly brittle.

In PaperGrader.js grade(), FormData is posted via `api.post('/paper-grader/grade', fd)` — ensure the shared axios instance does NOT set a hardcoded 'Content-Type: application/json' header for FormData bodies (works in this run, but a common footgun).
Nav data-testid contains a space: 'nav-paper grader' (from n.label.toLowerCase()). It works but a hyphenated slug ('nav-paper-grader') would be more robust for CSS selectors.
criterion-score-N badge uses conditional colors — works. All interactive elements have data-testid: good.
